facts.fact: Techtrends Africa reports the department published a Draft National AI Policy in the Government Gazette on 10 April 2026 following Cabinet approval, then withdrew it in late April over fabricated AI-generated references.
facts.system: Draft South Africa National AI Policy

facts.fact: Techtrends Africa reports a seven-member independent expert panel is rewriting the policy, with Cabinet resubmission targeted for November 2026 and a fresh public comment draft in January 2027.
facts.system: Draft South Africa National AI Policy
